newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted amid thin volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices quoted amid thin volume.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted amid thin activity Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
Sixteen barges traded versus four barges Thursday.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi River, 240 percent net 10, two each week of October - call, traded at 10 percent of tariff.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi, 240 percent net, 10, two each week of October, - call, traded at 10 percent.
- Two barges, St Louis, Mississippi, next week, no bid, offer 95 percent, no comparison.
- One barge, Dubuque, Iowa, Mississippi, next week, bid 130 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Eight barges, Illinois River, one each week of October, bid 225 percent, unchanged from Thursday, no offer.
